# RenG

Canonical documentation: https://rohittp.com/reng/
KMP setup: https://rohittp.com/reng/kmp.html
Source: https://github.com/rohittp0/RenG
Architecture decisions: https://github.com/rohittp0/RenG/tree/main/docs/adr

Maven coordinate: com.rohittp.reng:kmp
Public Maven repository after exact merged CI and anonymous first-release completion-record verification: https://maven.rohittp.com
Public release status: pending

Configured Kotlin Multiplatform targets, available together after that verification:
- android
- iosArm64
- iosSimulatorArm64
- macosArm64
- linuxX64
- linuxArm64

License: Apache-2.0

Releases are immutable and fail closed. Every non-documentation push to main publishes only after
validation; an occupied coordinate, malformed response, or validation failure stops publication rather
than overwriting or skipping a version. Routine next-patch advancement requires the newest metadata-listed
release's strict record at com/rohittp/reng/kmp/<version>/reng-release-completion-v1.json. POM and metadata
availability are not completion proof. The workflow conditionally creates the record only after anonymous
artifact/metadata verification and credential-free six-target resolution, then verifies it anonymously.

After both CI jobs pass the exact merged commit and the first public completion record verifies, an
authorized documentation-only follow-up must revise pending claims in CLAUDE.md, README.md,
docs/index.html, docs/kmp.html, and this file; adjust the docs/versions.js pending fallback if applicable;
and update HANDOFF.md plus docs/decomposition.md. ADR 0013 and the Cycle A design spec and implementation
plan remain historical decision records unless the release exposes a contract error. Public version display
remains metadata-driven.

RenG is pre-runtime in Cycle A. It exposes no runtime API and renders nothing.
